texts.zh:
我们在[gateway_system.GetName]星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为L-星团。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型纳米机器人建造的。

虽然星门散发着微弱的能量特征，但它被故意锁定在某种维护循环中，以防止其被激活。除非我们能设法解除这一过程，不然我们将无法抵达L-星团。
texts.en:
We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near [gateway_system.GetName]. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-instantaneous travel from one part of the galaxy to another.

At some point after its initial construction its connection to the rest of the network was severed. It now offers only one valid destination - an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that our astronomers have designated the L-Cluster. Even more intriguing, the Gateway was built entirely by microscopic Nanites of an unknown design.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.

texts.zh:
我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在[gateway_system.GetName]星系附近。此传送门是由我们从没见过的微型纳米机器人所建。

和之前的传送门不同，此传送门被人进行过大幅度的改动并和传送门网络断开了连接——现在该传送门只能通往一处位于我们星系之外的陌生星域，我们的天文学家将该星域称之为L-星团。

虽然此传送门有微弱的能源信号，但它被某种维护机制锁住了，因此无法启动。除非我们能设法停止维护机制，否则无法前往L-星团。
texts.en:
We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time near [gateway_system.GetName]. It appears to have been built entirely by microscopic Nanites of an unknown design.

Unlike the previous structure, this Gateway has been significantly altered since its initial construction. Its connection to the rest of the network has been severed - instead, the only valid destination is an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that has been designated the L-Cluster by our astronomers.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.

texts.zh:
我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过L-星门到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。

这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
texts.en:
We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through L-Gates, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for now we lack the necessary insight into the subspace mechanics that govern their use to lift the lockdown.

label.zh: 异常调查后约30%概率得到线索
label.en: About 30% of anomaly follow-ups yield a clue

label.zh: 邻国已收集超过5条线索并拥有L-星门
label.en: A neighbour has more than 5 clues and owns an L-Gate

texts.zh:
我们科研船最近一直在分析那个来自系外的声波信号，现在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科研团队终于取得了突破性进展。

尽管信号中的大部分声波方程的含义我们仍不清楚，但我们母星上的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][Root.GetScientistPlural]们已经确定该传输信号的数据与神秘L-星门上所用的科技数据是完全一致的！

单独进行分析的话，此信号的价值近乎为零，但如果将此信号与我们得到的关于远古传送门建造者的信息结合起来进行研究的话，可能就会让我们知道该如何重新启动这些L-星门。
texts.en:
Something of a breakthrough has been reached within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientific community regarding the extragalactic sonified signal one of our Science Ships recently analyzed.

While the full meaning of the sonified equation embedded in the signal still eludes us, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetScientistPlural] on our home world have been able to match enough of the transmission's data on subspace harmonics to the technology observed in the mysterious L-Gates!

Examined in isolation, the signal is of little further use to us. Analyzing it in conjunction with other insights into the ancient Gateway Builders, however, may yield valuable data on how these L-Gates could be reactivated.

texts.zh: 我们发现神秘容器上面的外星化合物是由纳米机器人的粉末组成的。外壳上的一些划痕中甚至有微小的机械爪痕，其中一个爪痕上有个纳米机器人正在从储存器中吸取能源。我们从纳米机器人的存储设备中提取到了一些数据，这些数据可以帮助我们更好地理解L-星团的传送门网络。
texts.en: We have discovered that the alien compound found on the enigmatic cache is made up of the powdered fragments of microscopic robotic entities - nanites. Some of the scratches in the hull even have tiny mechanical claws stuck in them, and in one we discovered an active but damaged nanite leeching its energy from the cache. From what remained of the nanite's hard drive we have extracted data that could be pivotal for our understanding of the L-cluster Gateway network.

texts.zh:
从[big_rip_planet.GetName]的废墟中回收的众多物品中有一个全息图像，该全息图像来自于某个对植物类[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]生活进行干涉的社会。虽然全息图像中的大部分数据已经损坏的难以辨识，我们还是成功的恢复了几个含有关于传送门网络的关键信息的片段。

大部分全息图像似乎是用来警告灰色风暴将会带来的毁灭性灾难的。
texts.en:
Among the items recovered from the ruins on [big_rip_planet.GetName] was a malfunctioning hologram from the society that interfered with the plantoid [GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. Though most of the data was either corrupted or unintelligible due to an incessant whooshing sound and the panicked state of the sender, we managed to restore several fragments containing valuable information on the Gateway network.

Most of the hologram, however, was dedicated to sickening premonitions of the Gray Tempest and the gruesome death that would follow in its wake.

texts.zh:
出于安全考虑，我们给所有从西万实验室返回的船员们都进行了全面的消毒，在消毒过程中，我们发现船员的防护外套上面附有某种外星物质，经过仔细研究发现这是某种变成了灰色尘埃的微型机器人碎片。最后我们在这些外星物质中找到了一个完整的纳米机器人，该机器人身上携带着给某个建筑安装螺栓的指令，我们认为那个建筑应该是一个传送门。

这个纳米机器人从事的工作应该是“组装整个L-星门网络”这一系统工程中的一小部分。
texts.en:
As the crew returning from the Xvan labs were decontaminated we identified an alien substance on their protective wear. Upon closer examination it has proven to be fragments of microscopic robots turned into a fine gray dust. Among the samples we found an intact nanite carrying instructions for attaching bolts to a structure we believe could be a Gateway.

This molecular construct maybe have had an integral part in assembling the entire L-Gate network.

texts.zh: 虽然当时并不明显，但[From.GetName]最近进行的勘探，在报告传回[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学界之后，似乎使L-星门谜团的研究有了突破性的进展。
texts.en: It was not immediately apparent at the time, but the recent survey carried out by the [From.GetName] seemingly sparked a breakthrough in the ongoing study of the mysterious L-Gates when the report filtered back to the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们已对L-星门有了足够的认知，可以开始研究其背后的科技。研究完成之后，我们应该可以派一艘科研船来中断其无限维护循环。

L-星团已经触手可及了！
texts.en:
We have now gathered sufficient L-Gate insights to research the technology behind them. Once this has been done, one of our Science Ships should be able to abort the perpetual maintenance cycle they are stuck in.

The L-Cluster is almost within our reach!

label.zh: 研究“星门激活”科技且拥有L-星门
label.en: Research the L-Gate activation tech while owning an L-Gate

label.zh: 研究该科技但没有L-星门
label.en: Research the tech without owning an L-Gate

texts.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

当维护机制解除后，星系内的其他L-星门在自纠错软件的调整之下也会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们现在可以毫无阻碍的探索星团，这让我们比其他人领先一大步。
texts.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort their maintenance cycle. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

As the maintenance cycle ends, any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years as their self-correcting software readjusts. Still, this will give us a significant headstart to explore the cluster without interference.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

虽然星系内的其他L-星门会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们显然可以比其他人领先一大步。
texts.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort the maintenance cycle they have been locked into. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

Any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years, but this should give us a significant headstart.

texts.zh:
虽然我们已经掌握了不少关于L-星门的知识和科技，但目前我们手中并没有L-星门。

如果我们要继续进行计划的话，就必须从某个星系中取得L-星门的控制权。
texts.en:
Although we have accumulated a lot of information about the L-Gates and their technology, we are not in possession of an actual gate.

Before this project can continue, we must gain ownership of a system with an L-Gate.

label.zh: 那我们就想办法控制一个L-星门好了。
label.en: Then we shall secure an L-Gate.

label.zh: 虽然听上去挺有意思，但我们不能再让这种事情分散我们的精力了。
label.en: An interesting diversion, but it ends now.

texts.zh:
我方特工报告称，[lgate_warning_country.GetName]手中掌握的情报与信息，距离打开他们控制下的L-星门已经只有一步之遥。这样一来，他们就会取得L-星团的所有秘密与使用权限！

如果想抢先一步，我们就必须着力研究L-星门，尽快掌握它的内幕！
texts.en:
Our spies report that the [lgate_warning_country.GetName] is close to possessing enough information about the L-Gates to unlock the one they control. This would give them access to the L-Cluster and its secrets!

If we are to get there first, we must double our efforts and find more insights into the L-Gates!

label.zh: 那么就看看我们谁比较快吧。
label.en: We shall see who gets there first.

texts.zh:
L-星龙已被消灭，而我们的科学家已经开始分析其仍留着温度的遗骸。

有趣的是，它的细胞内完全没有传统的遗传标记，或是任何像是DNA的东西。每个细胞似乎都是在分子水平上单独组成的，然后构成了我们所见到的从L-星门中出现的生物。报告表明在龙的脑干中发现了少量停止的纳米机器，进一步暗示了其荒诞的起源。
texts.en:
The L-Drake has been slain, and our scientists are beginning to tear into its still-warm carcass.

Interestingly, the creature's cells are completely devoid of traditional genetic markers or indeed anything resembling DNA. Each cell appears to have been put together individually, at the molecular level, and then assembled into the creature we saw emerge from the L-Gate. Reports indicate trace amounts of inactive nanomachines in the dragon's brainstem, which further hints at a truly bizarre origin.

texts.zh: 被消灭的龙与我们之前遭遇的任何太空生物在分类学上都没有明显的联系。光谱分析同时也显示，它要么是先前在附近星系中观察到的亚空间扰动的原因，要么是其结果。
texts.en: The slain dragon has no obvious taxonomic link to any other spaceborne life that we have previously encountered. It is also, spectral analysis tells us, either the cause or the effect of the subspace disruption previously observed in a system not far from here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]进入了[From.GetName]星系，并正在观察环绕恒星飞行的L星龙。

这只生物似乎迷路了，但注意到了我们舰船的存在。尽管它没有靠近，它环绕飞行的路线中现在包括了几乎是嬉戏一般的俯冲与飞掠，似乎是在向[Root.GetName]示意。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has entered the [From.GetName] system and is observing the L-Drake circling the star.

The creature seems lost, but has noted our vessel's presence. While it does not approach, its circuitous route now incorporates an almost playful plunge and sweep, seemingly directed at the [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 或许我们可以与它沟通。
label.en: Perhaps we can communicate with it.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]星系内的L-星龙似乎很温顺——至少目前如此。

如果它有智慧，我们或许可以与其结盟并从中受益。
texts.en:
The L-Drake in the [From.GetName] system appears docile - for now.

If it is intelligent, we could benefit from attempting to ally with the beast.

texts.zh:
奇怪的是，L-星龙对使用敌我识别系统的波长的通讯广播有很强的接收反应。

科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]开发出了一套L-星龙可以解读并乐于执行的复杂指令——这样它就不至于因为对我们的科研船感兴趣而频繁的与舰体发生冲撞了。
texts.en:
Oddly enough, the L-Drake responds well to transmissions broadcast at wavelengths usually reserved for IFF systems.

Science Officer [From.GetLeaderName] has developed a fairly sophisticated set of commands that the L-Drake is able to interpret and will happily execute - in exchange for the occasional friendly wrestling match with one of our Science Ships.

note.zh: 项目完成后，该恒星系归你所有。
note.en: After the project the system is yours.

texts.zh:
成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。

我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！
texts.en:
Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.

For the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy!

note.zh: 无危机的结局：L-星团开放，其他L-星门之后每200-700天陆续启用（distar.10960）。
note.en: The quiet ending: the cluster is open and other L-Gates activate one by one every 200-700 days (distar.10960).

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的L-星团了。

但这样一来，我们就无法启动我们这个星系的L-星门了。现在除了已经可以正常使用的那个L-星门之外，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。

现在如果我们想前往遥远星团的话，只能使用[From.GetName]掌控之下的那个传送门了！
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

Unfortunately, this has halted our own project to activate an L-Gate. Aside from the one that is functional, all other L-Gates in the galaxy have now activated some sort of self-correcting software that should terminate their maintenance cycles within a matter of years.

For now, however, the only way to reach the star cluster is through the gate belonging to the [From.GetName]!

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]在自己境内成功地恢复了某种远古亚空间传送门的电源，现在他们能到达我们星系边缘的某个被隔离的星团了！这个星团被他们称为“L-星团”，这个星团无法经由超空间抵达，只能通过这些L-星门。
texts.en: By restoring power to some sort of ancient subspace gateway within their borders, the [From.GetName] has gained access to an isolated star cluster on the periphery of our galaxy! This group of stars, which they refer to as the "L-Cluster," cannot be reached by hyperlane - only through these L-Gates.

texts.zh:
我们打开了通往L-星团的大门，却发现另一边有什么东西在等着我们。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为L-星龙的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
texts.en:
We pried open the gate to the L-Cluster, only to find something waiting for us on the other side. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gates had been fully stabilized, it broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the L-Drake has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

texts.zh:
[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系内的L-星门开启了，传送门网络似乎被另一个帝国打开了。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为L-星龙的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
texts.en:
The L-Gate in the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system has become active, the network seemingly pried open by a foreign state. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gate had fully stabilized, something broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the L-Drake has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

label.zh: 科学船抵达幼龙所在恒星
label.en: A science ship reaches the star where a young L-Drake waits

texts.zh:
传感器侦测到数个同步的亚空间扰动，最近的一个位于[disturbance_system.GetName]星系。

扰动正在迅速减弱，但我们仍未判明造成扰动的原因。
texts.en:
Sensors indicate several synchronous subspace disruptions, the closest one reported in the [disturbance_system.GetName] system.

The disturbances are rapidly subsiding, but we have yet to determine what caused them.

summary.text:
# L-星团 / The L-Cluster

- 分类 Category：探索 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（部分审阅 partial）
- 来源 Sources：events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:2366-2410 (distar.13080); events/apocalypse_events.txt:80-98 (apoc.3, same chain start); common/event_chains/00_event_chains_distant_stars.txt:25 (l_cluster_chain, max 7 clues); common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3243 (generate_lcluster_clue); common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3291 (pop_lcluster_event); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1141 (distar.9000); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1280 (distar.10904); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2698 (distar.10903); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1196-1303 (distar.10900-10905); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:650 (LCLUSTER_PROJECT); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1331-1428 (distar.10950); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1109-1129 (distar.8000); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1812-2142 (distar.13000-13035); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1498-1566 (distar.10955/10956)

## 如何开始 How it starts

拥有《遥远繁星》时，银河里有被封存的L-星门（abandoned lgate_base 巨型建筑）。国家第一次看到一座（在外国领土内、未经科学船勘测则触发 distar.13080；经科学船勘测则触发 apoc.3，另一故事）就设置标志 encountered_first_lgate，并通过 start_lcluster_chain 开启事件链“L-星团”。

With Distant Stars the galaxy contains sealed L-Gates (lgate_base megastructures). The first time a country sees one (distar.13080 when it lies in foreign territory and was not surveyed by a science ship; apoc.3, another story, when surveyed) it sets the flag encountered_first_lgate and starts the event chain "The L-Cluster" through start_lcluster_chain.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.13080“遗弃星门”：发现L-星门，开始事件链“L-星团”（7条线索）。
2. 收集线索：之后许多异常的结果事件会调用 pop_lcluster_event（约30%概率在10天后触发 distar.9000“L-星门线索”）或直接调用 generate_lcluster_clue；可重复科技 tech_repeatable_lcluster_clue 也会产生线索。7条线索齐全 → distar.10904“已收集好L-星门的线索”：解锁研究 tech_lgate_activation。
3. 研究该科技：若拥有L-星门 → distar.10905“打开L-星团”，启用项目 LCLUSTER_PROJECT“启动L-星门”（科学船+科学家，180天；他国先开则中止）；若没有 → distar.10901“需要L-星门”（每60天复查，或放弃线索换取最多3500工程研究与能量）。
4. 项目完成 → distar.10950（隐藏）：设置 l_cluster_opened，生成L-星团的星系，激活这座星门，并按开局已决定的全局标志发生四种结局之一：灰色风暴危机（graygoo.1，另一故事）、龙之季（distar.13000 → 13010“L-星龙出现”/13011“释放未知”）、灰雾帝国（graygoo.100，另一故事）、或平静的 distar.10951“链接已建立”（其余L-星门之后陆续启用）。其他国家随后收到 distar.10952（中止项目）/10953/10954（得知星团已开）通知。
5. 龙之季的后续：科学船到达幼龙所在恒星 → distar.13030“观察到L-星龙”，可启动项目 TAME_LDRAGON_PROJECT“驯服L-星龙”（180天）→ distar.13035；或击杀L-星龙 → distar.13020“被消灭”（每月影响力与矿物，已知时再加研究）。
6. 旁支：邻国线索超过5条且拥有L-星门时，你会收到 distar.10956“L-星团的召唤”。

1. distar.13080 "Abandoned Gateway": the L-Gate is found and the event chain "The L-Cluster" (7 clues) begins.
2. Collecting clues: the outcomes of many later anomalies call pop_lcluster_event (about 30% to fire distar.9000 "L-Gate Insights" 10 days later) or generate_lcluster_clue directly; the repeatable tech tech_repeatable_lcluster_clue also yields clues. With all 7 clues → distar.10904 "L-Gate Insights Gathered" unlocks the research tech_lgate_activation.
3. Researching it: if you own an L-Gate → distar.10905 "Opening the L-Cluster" enables project LCLUSTER_PROJECT "Activate L-Gate" (science ship and scientist, 180 days; aborted if another country opens first); if not → distar.10901 "L-Gate Needed" (re-checked every 60 days, or liquidate the clues for up to 3500 engineering research and energy).
4. Project complete → distar.10950 (hidden): sets l_cluster_opened, spawns the L-Cluster systems, activates this gate, and one of four outcomes happens according to a global flag fixed at game start: the Gray Tempest crisis (graygoo.1, another story), dragon season (distar.13000 → 13010 "L-Drakes Emerge" / 13011 "Unknowns Unleashed"), a gray goo empire (graygoo.100, another story), or the quiet distar.10951 "Link Established" (the other L-Gates activate over time). Other countries then get distar.10952 (project aborted) / 10953 / 10954 (the cluster is open).
5. Dragon season follow-up: a science ship reaching the star of a young L-Drake → distar.13030 "L-Drake Observed", which can start project TAME_LDRAGON_PROJECT (180 days) → distar.13035; or killing an L-Drake → distar.13020 "Slayed" (monthly influence and minerals, plus research if known).
6. Side branch: when a neighbour has more than 5 clues and owns an L-Gate you get distar.10956 "The L-Cluster Beckons".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

开启后的四种结局互斥，且在新游戏开局时就已抽定（权重 50/30/30/30；禁用破坏性玩法时灰色风暴权重为0）；龙之季之后“驯服”与“击杀”是两种并行的处理方式。

The four outcomes after opening are mutually exclusive and are rolled at new-game start (weights 50/30/30/30; the gray-goo crisis drops to 0 when disruptive gameplay is blocked); after dragon season, taming and killing are two parallel ways to deal with a drake.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.13030 的驯服选项禁止杀戮与狂热排外帝国；13020 的奖励按是否已知晓L-星龙变化；9000 的正文按线索来源（声波、三种描述）变化。

distar.13030's taming option is disallowed for homicidal and fanatic xenophobe empires; distar.13020's reward depends on whether the L-Drake was already known; distar.9000's text varies with the clue source (sonic, three descriptions).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对 distar.8000–13080 的相关事件、事件链、线索脚本效果、on_action 和 LCLUSTER_PROJECT / TAME_LDRAGON_PROJECT。修正：草稿把“打开星团”“线索”“龙之季后续”“邻国预警”分成七个互不相连的故事；现合为一个从 distar.13080 开始的故事，并按真实顺序用审阅连接串起（链→线索→7条线索→研究→项目→结局→龙之季）。灰色风暴（graygoo.1）与灰雾帝国（graygoo.100）属其他故事，仅作外链。

Checked the related events of distar.8000-13080, the event chain, the clue script effects, the on_actions and LCLUSTER_PROJECT / TAME_LDRAGON_PROJECT. Correction: the draft split opening, clues, the dragon aftermath and the neighbour warning into seven unconnected stories; they are now one story from distar.13080 with reviewed links in the real order (chain → clues → 7 clues → research → project → outcome → dragon season). The Gray Tempest (graygoo.1) and gray goo empire (graygoo.100) belong to other stories and appear only as external links.
